Neural Network (machine learning)
An artificial neural network is an interconnected group of nodes, inspired by a simplification of neurons in a brain. Here, each circular node represents an artificial neuron and an arrow represents a connection from the output of one artificial neuron to the input of another. In machine learning, a neural network (also artificial neural network or neural net, abbreviated ANN or NN) is a computational model inspired by the structure and functions of biological neural networks.
summary: A neural network is a computational model inspired by biological neural networks, using interconnected nodes.

In applications such as playing video games, an actor takes a string of actions, receiving a generally unpredictable response from the environment after each one. The goal is to win the game, i.e., generate the most positive (lowest cost) responses. In reinforcement learning, the aim is to weight the network (devise a policy) to perform actions that minimize long-term (expected cumulative) cost.

Applications
Because of their ability to reproduce and model nonlinear processes, artificial neural networks have found applications in many disciplines. These include:

Function approximation,[168] or regression analysis,[169] (including time series prediction, fitness approximation,[170] and modeling)
Data processing[171] (including filtering, clustering, blind source separation,[172] and compression)
Nonlinear system identification[93] and control (including vehicle control, trajectory prediction,[173] adaptive control, process control, and natural resource management)
Pattern recognition (including radar systems, face identification, signal classification,[174] novelty detection, 3D reconstruction,[175] object recognition, and sequential decision making[176])
Sequence recognition (including gesture, speech, and handwritten and printed text recognition[177])
Sensor data analysis[178] (including image analysis)
Robotics (including directing manipulators and prostheses)
Data mining (including knowledge discovery in databases)
Finance[179] (such as ex-ante models for specific financial long-run forecasts and artificial financial markets)
Quantum chemistry[180]
General game playing[181]
Generative AI[182]
Data visualization
Machine translation
Social network filtering[183]
E-mail spam filtering
Medical diagnosis[184]
ANNs have been used to diagnose several types of cancers[185][186] and to distinguish highly invasive cancer cell lines from less invasive lines using only cell shape information.
summary: Artificial neural networks model nonlinear processes and are applied in fields like data processing, pattern recognition, and medical diagnosis.
